Spear was born from a simple insight:Outbound Works When the Timing is Right

The Unlikely Experiment

We bootstrapped a weird idea - selling personalized coffee mugs to HR managers. No marketing budget. Just outbound. It grew to 30,000 units and over $1M in revenue.

But the real discovery wasn't the mugs. It was the method. Reach the right person, with the right message, at the exact right moment - and everything changes.

The Pattern 
We Couldn't Ignore

After COVID, we founded an SDR-as-a-Service agency and met with more than 1,000 GTM teams. The same story everywhere: SDRs missing quota, buyers ignoring generic outreach, volume mistaken for pipeline.These weren't abstract problems to us. We had lived them ourselves. So we built the thing we wished had existed - trigger-based outbound designed around how modern buyers actually engage. That became Spear.

Meet Our Founding Team

  • Dor Vardi

    CEO & Co-Founder

    Dor met with over 1,000 GTM teams before co-founding Spear. He's seen every outbound playbook, and exactly where they break down. Spear is his answer to that.

  • Yotam Nahum

    CTO & Co-Founder

    Yotam is an award-winning deep learning researcher (Columbia, IDC) whose work focuses on how emotion drives behavior across social networks.

  • Gadi Vardi

    COO & Co-Founder

    Gadi spent over a decade in B2B sales at Cisco and brings deep operational and commercial expertise to building repeatable outbound systems.
